title: An Archdemon's Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Zagan, a feared and socially awkward sorcerer, falls in love at first sight with Nephy, an elf slave at a dark auction, and spends his whole fortune to buy her. Neither knows how to express affection, and their halting romance unfolds while Zagan becomes one of the thirteen Archdemons and fends off rival sorcerers and the church's knights. He breaks her slave collar and offers her freedom; she chooses to stay, and they adopt a dragon girl.
life_message: Even someone feared as a monster can learn tenderness, and love means choosing the other's freedom.

winners_losers: Zagan, Nephy and their household win; slavers, rival archdemons and the militant church lose. Sympathy goes to the misunderstood sorcerer.
